interpretation: Ranges in sample-size-analysis.json are prospective sensitivity results, not observed power. Unknown nuisance parameters prevent a unique justified N.

model.binding: LOW S05 and HIGH replacement probabilities varied 0.55-0.90; conjunctive success
model.heterogeneity: repository SD 0.05-0.15; task SD 0.10-0.30; difficulty fixed effect; attrition 0/0.10/0.25
model.paired_binary: correlated Bernoulli acceptance with LOW baseline 0.25-0.60, HIGH risk difference 0/0.10/0.20, within-pair correlation 0.1-0.6
model.throughput: lognormal active time, HIGH relative effect 0/0.15/0.30, CV 0.35-0.80

reported_ranges_provenance: The ranges in sample-size-analysis.json are planning-only analytic/sensitivity approximations. They are not outputs from Monte Carlo simulation or from simulate.py.
reproducibility_note: simulate.py regenerates only the 13 synthetic determination rehearsals. It does not execute this power model. A deterministic Monte Carlo implementation and its output remain prospective-amendment deliverables.
